title: Stop reporting a binary as fresh when doctor could not probe it
action: In binary_freshness_row, stop the ProbedBeeVersion::Failed arm from falling through into the row that asserts the binary matches source. Keep the mtime scan running and still winning when it finds a newer input; when the probe failed and nothing is newer, return ok: None with a detail naming the failed probe and its remedy, never a version it did not read. Add a test for that one new cell of the matrix.
acceptance: A tree whose binary cannot be probed with nothing newer yields ok:None naming the failed probe and never the words 'matches source'; the same tree with a newer source input still yields ok:Some(false) with its existing detail; Present-equal, Present-differing and Missing keep their current rows with the existing tests unedited and green.
